act32.registration: Register each worksite with the designated local collector. Obtain residency certification and worksite and residence PSD codes.
returns: Employer Quarterly Return
File and pay by the last day of the month after quarter end. An eligible employer electing combined filing reports and pays electronically each month.
W2-R
Annual employer reconciliation, generally due the last day of February. Consult the assigned collector for year-end and cessation instructions.
